response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions), above_overall AS (SELECT oa.avg_unfilled, oa.avg_unfilled - o.avg_unfilled AS excess_overall FROM order_averages oa CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE oa.avg_unfilled > o.avg_unfilled), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.avg_unfilled) AS average_unfilled, AVG(a.excess_overall) AS average_excess_overall, AVG(a.avg_unfilled - g.avg_unfilled) AS average_excess_group FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN group_average g WHERE a.avg_unfilled > g.avg_unfilled
